title: fastlane_require 'posix/spawn' Unable to resolve dependency
body:
### New Issue Checklist - [x] Updated fastlane to the latest version - [x] I have read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### Issue Description Fastlane require fails on posix spawn. The gem is called `posix-spawn`. ``` fastlane_require 'posix/spawn' ``` ``` `add_always_install': [!] Unable to resolve dependency: user requested 'posix/spawn (>= 0)' (Gem::UnsatisfiableDependencyError) ``` ### Environment Please run `fastlane env` and copy the output below.
